verdict.rationale: A law firm handling client data, including through its Clerky formation workflow, could reasonably commit not to use that data for AI training, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no AI-training opt-out or data-use policy. The Data Privacy practice is legal advice to clients about their own compliance, which is an adjacent service, not a control over the firm's use of user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
